metadata.description: Evidently-style learner profiles seeding synthetic dialogue generation (data_instruction.md §'Thiết kế Kịch bản Đối thoại ESL'). Each profile pins persona × CEFR × L1-transfer focus × scenario so LLM emits realistic Vietnamese-English ESL errors.
metadata.usage: Load via data_pipeline.synthetic.SyntheticPipeline.sample_seeds(profiles, k) before each LLM expansion call.

profiles.scenario: describing what I did yesterday after school
profiles.notes: Tends to drop 'be' before adjectives ('I tired') and use base verb for past ('Yesterday I go').

profiles.scenario: introducing my family to a new classmate
profiles.notes: Skips 'a/an/the' before singular countable nouns; misses -s on 3rd-person singular.
Places adjective after noun ('coffee hot') under Vietnamese SVO influence; confuses 'borrow/lend'.
'I am study English every day' (redundant be); mixes simple past and present perfect.

profiles.occupation: marketing junior at an e-commerce startup
profiles.scenario: writing a Slack message to summarise a campaign result
profiles.notes: 'Although ... but ...' pattern; 'I studied always my report' (adverb after verb).

profiles.scenario: pitching a quarterly proposal to an English-speaking client
profiles.notes: False friends ('actually' = 'currently' from VN 'thực ra'); occasional missing articles in long noun phrases.

profiles.scenario: filing a detailed bug report in English
profiles.notes: Edge cases: collective noun agreement ('the team are/is'), past perfect vs simple past ordering.

profiles.scenario: reviewing a junior's English documentation and leaving comments
profiles.notes: Subtle adverb position ('I have always been doing' vs 'I always have been doing'); register-shifting verbs.

profiles.occupation: primary-school English teacher in a rural province
profiles.scenario: explaining a lesson to a parent over the phone
profiles.notes: Strong VN syntactic transfer in spoken sentences; pauses often.

profiles.scenario: writing a quick blog intro at 11pm
profiles.notes: Tired-state errors increase: drops articles, mixes adjective order.

profiles.scenario: delivering a technical talk at a public meetup
profiles.notes: Mostly accurate but occasional false friends and present perfect overuse.

profiles.occupation: retiree learning English to talk to grandchildren abroad
profiles.scenario: video call greeting at the start of a weekly chat
profiles.notes: Very limited vocab; relies on memorised greetings; high motivation, low accuracy.
